author: Cleo Abram
description:
If I jump into my computer and I see it’s getting HOT – that whirring noise - what is happening? 

All computers need to get the heat off the chip as quickly as possible and find somewhere to dump it

This is a HEAT problem that’s holding back virtually all our cutting edge computers, because most of what’s around me right now is made of… silicon. 

But now there’s a new material we think might be able to help.

To see what, watch our longer video and subscribe!

#computer #silicon #diamond #heat #computing
title: What If I Shrink Into My Computer?
